a114.titolo: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
a114.testo: Google is bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI in your car. With this update, Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in can tap into your information across Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, YouTube, and Search. Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car Gemini AI can now draw from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, Photos, and other apps while you drive. As an example, Google says you can ask Gemini about your flight status if you’re driving to the airport. The AI assistant can pull your flight details from a confirmation message in Gmail and then use that information to look up the status. You can also ask Gemini to “take me to my doctor’s appointment” instead of pulling up directions manually, or ask it to “find the car wash from the photo I took last week and navigate there.” Google brought its Gemini assistant to Android Auto last year before rolling it out to cars with Google built-in in April. Several carmakers—including Ford, GM, Honda, Nissan, Volvo, and Polestar—have shipped newer cars with Google built-in, which adds support for native Android apps. Google says it will connect your apps to Gemini only if you enable its Personal Intelligence setting. It will also share personalized responses only if you have your phone connected to your car. “If you don’t use Personal Intelligence, everything in the car still works: You can use navigation, listen to music, make calls, and ask questions, but the answers won’t be tailored to you,” Google says. Personal Intelligence is rolling out to Android Auto today, with support coming to cars with Google built-in in the coming months.

a78.titolo: Get hands-free personalized help on the road with Gemini
a78.testo: Get hands-free personalized help on the road with Gemini Gemini — your helpful AI assistant — is now available globally on Android Auto and cars with Google built-in. With Gemini, you can speak naturally to get more done or brainstorm ideas while driving. An assistant is even more helpful when it knows the world and knows you. That’s why we’re rolling out Personal Intelligence with Gemini starting today, 1 to give you uniquely tailored answers and make Gemini even more valuable on the road. With your permission, Personal Intelligence securely connects information from the Google apps you already use — Workspace (including Gmail and Google Calendar), Google Photos, Google Maps, YouTube, and Search. Just ask — Gemini gets it Personal Intelligence has two core strengths: retrieving specific details from, say, an email, photo or a place you saved in Google Maps to answer your question and reasoning across complex sources. That’s especially helpful when your hands are on the wheel. Personal Intelligence does the heavy lifting so you can speak naturally, without having to explain context or dig for information. Here are a few examples. - Make complex requests: On your way to the airport, ask, “What's my flight gate? And is my flight on time?” You don’t have to hunt for the confirmation email, then do a separate search for delays. Gemini gives you both answers in one go. - Get personalized picks every time: Looking for dinner in an unfamiliar town? Say, “Find me an indoor restaurant along my route that matches my usual vibe.” If you're vegetarian, you'll get a shortlist of places that fit your needs. - Speak naturally: Heading to an appointment? a16.titolo: Penmentor – Claude marks up your handwritten math like a teacher
a16.testo: A maths mentor at the tip of your pen. Press a key while you work by hand: Claude, Gemini or GPT marks your work on the screen like a teacher with coloured pens, gives you hints instead of answers, and shows the idea as a 3Blue1Brown-style animation. Handwriting in xournal++ → one key → the slip is marked on the page → box the integral → an interactive manim animation. (video; for a repeatable recording the pen is scripted and the model's answer is a fixed example.) I study calculus with a pen tablet in xournal++. I kept screenshotting my work into Claude and reading long answers back, when what I wanted was a teacher looking over my shoulder: circle the mistake, tick what's right, nudge me toward the next step, and show me why. penmentor is that, one key away, on my own Claude subscription. - Hints, not answers. A ladder from a nudge to naming the technique to a faint ghost of the next line: you do the thinking, which is what makes it stick. - Feedback on your own work. The first real mistake circled where you made it, correct lines ticked, later lines that inherit the mistake underlined. The marks stay while you keep writing; Esc clears them. - Practice that makes you recall. Questions on your key steps (answer by typing or by writing), find-the-error drills, "which technique fits?". - See it. Box what you want to understand and get an interactive animation made with 3Blue1Brown's own manim: drag the bounds, retype a value, watch Riemann sums close in. - Whole page aware. A small xournal++ plugin shares the page you are on, not just what fits on screen. penmentor runs on the AI command-line agent you already use, on that subscription. u2a176.titolo: ChatGPT: come bloccare le chat con PIN, Face ID o Touch ID
u2a176.testo: OpenAI ha appena annunciato le Locked Chats, le Chat Bloccate. In pratica, si può bloccare una conversazione proteggendola con un PIN di quattro cifre. Sui dispositivi compatibili si può usare anche Face ID o Touch ID. Non serve altro. Arrivano le chat di ChatGPT private La chat bloccata sparisce dalla cronologia normale e finisce in una sezione dedicata, chiamata appunto “Locked Chats”. Lì sta separata da tutto il resto, dalla lista delle conversazioni, da quelle fissate in alto e perfino dai risultati della ricerca. Chi sfoglia l’app in propria assenza, o accanto, non ne troverà traccia. ChatGPT aveva già le chat temporanee, ma sono un’altra cosa. Aprono una sessione a parte che non lascia segni nella cronologia. OpenAI fa un esempio. Si sta parlando di qualcosa di personale, oppure si sta organizzando una sorpresa. Poi si deve passare il telefono a un amico o a un parente per mostrargli qualcosa in un’altra chat, e non si vuole che il resto si veda. Ci sta. La memoria L’aspetto più interessante è la memoria. Chi ha attivato la funzione non ha di che temere, le Chat Bloccate ne ricevono una tutta loro, condivisa solo tra le conversazioni bloccate. I messaggi che si scrivono dopo aver messo il lucchetto aggiornano quella memoria separata e non toccano quella normale. Il lucchetto non protegge da tutto Qui OpenAI è stata onesta, e conviene leggere con attenzione. Bloccare una chat limita chi può aprirla dal tuo schermo. Non cambia però quello che succede ai dati dietro le quinte. In concreto, bloccare una conversazione: - Non crea una crittografia end-to-end né una cassaforte cifrata a parte; - Non cambia per quanto tempo OpenAI conserva la chat; - Non cancella ciò che ChatGPT aveva già memorizzato prima del blocco; - Non modifica l’impostazione “Improve the model for …

notizie.riassunto: Ora è possibile proteggere singole conversazioni su ChatGPT con un PIN di quattro cifre o tramite riconoscimento biometrico come Face ID e Touch ID. La chat protetta viene spostata in una sezione dedicata e isolata dalla cronologia principale e dai risultati di ricerca, offrendo una memoria separata per evitare che occhi indiscreti vedano i contenuti personali.
